name: independent-install-firstrun
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: Open the installed origin and reach Set up OpenLaw
steps.actual: The published origin http://127.0.0.1:43360 served Set up OpenLaw on a database with no users, at http://127.0.0.1:43360/auth/setup

steps.action: Create the first Administrator through the documented form
steps.actual: Fictional Avery Morgan was created as the first Administrator and the wizard opened Welcome to OpenLaw. No email was configured at this point, so initial account creation does not need a relay.

steps.action: Configure the owned relay in the welcome wizard and send a real test email
steps.actual: The wizard saved the relay and Send test email delivered a real message to the owned Mailpit: subject "OpenLaw test email", to avery.morgan@helix.example.

steps.action: Invite a colleague and check the link carries the installed origin
steps.error:
locator.click: Timeout 20000ms exceeded.
